source_document: Banking & Finance Collection Field Guide v1.0

scenarios.text_scenario: Salary just came in and you want to see how much is in your account right now.
examples: Mera account balance kitna hai bata do
Balance check karo zara
Account mein kitne paise aaye hain?

scenarios.text_scenario: You are at a shop about to pay and quickly want to confirm you have enough money.
examples: Jaldi batao balance kitna hai
Mere paas kitne paise hain account mein?
Balance dekh ke batao abhi

scenarios.text_scenario: You are checking on your savings account rather than your main one.
examples: Savings account ka balance batao
Dusre account mein kitna hai?
Mera saving wala balance check karo

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to see your last few transactions to work out where your money went this week.
examples: Last 5 transactions dikha do
Mini statement bhej do mera
Recent transactions ka statement chahiye

scenarios.text_scenario: You are checking whether a payment you made yesterday actually went through.
examples: Kal ke transactions dikhao
Statement nikaalo last week ka
Pichhle kuch transactions batao

scenarios.text_scenario: You split a dinner bill and need to send your friend his share.
examples: Rahul ko 500 rupaye transfer karne hain
Mujhe paise bhejne hain kisi ko
Ek payment karni hai account mein

scenarios.text_scenario: You need to send money home to your family.
examples: Ghar paise bhejne hain
Mummy ke account mein transfer kar do
Do hazaar rupaye send karo papa ko

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to move money between two of your own accounts.
examples: Apne dusre account mein paise daalo
Savings se current mein transfer karo
Amount shift karna hai ek account se dusre mein

scenarios.text_scenario: You just realised your debit card is missing from your wallet and want it blocked immediately.
examples: Mera card kho gaya, turant block kar do!
Debit card block karna hai abhi
Jaldi mera card band kar do please

scenarios.text_scenario: Your phone shows a transaction you did not make and you want the card stopped before anything else happens.
examples: Card block karo jaldi, koi use kar raha hai
Abhi ke abhi card band karo
Mera card freeze kar do turant

scenarios.text_scenario: You see a transaction you never made and want to report it as fraud.
examples: Meri account se galat transaction hua hai
Ye payment maine nahi ki, fraud report karo
Koi mere paise nikaal raha hai, help karo

scenarios.text_scenario: You clicked a suspicious link and now money is missing from your account.
examples: Mere saath fraud ho gaya hai
Paise cut gaye bina permission ke
Complaint darj karni hai fraud ki

scenarios.text_scenario: You applied for a new card two weeks ago and want to know where it is.
examples: Meri new card kab tak aayegi?
Card ka status batao
Card dispatch hua ya nahi?

scenarios.text_scenario: You received a card but are not sure whether it is active yet.
examples: Card activate hua ya nahi?
Ye card chalu hai kya?
Card ki status check karo

scenarios.text_scenario: You forgot your ATM PIN and cannot withdraw cash.
examples: ATM pin bhool gaya, reset karna hai
Naya pin set karna hai card ka
Mera pin change kar do

scenarios.text_scenario: You think someone may have seen you enter your PIN and want to change it as a precaution.
examples: Pin badalna hai mera
Security ke liye pin change karo
Naya pin banana hai

scenarios.text_scenario: You are considering a personal loan and want to know the monthly EMI.
examples: Personal loan ka EMI kitna hoga?
Loan lene pe kitna monthly dena padega?
EMI calculate kar ke batao

scenarios.text_scenario: You are thinking about buying a house and want to know if you qualify.
examples: Home loan ke liye eligible hun kya?
Loan ke liye kya documents chahiye?
Mujhe home loan ke baare mein jaanna hai

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to compare interest rates before deciding.
examples: Interest rate kya chal raha hai?
Loan ka rate kitna hai abhi?
Kitna interest lagega loan pe?

scenarios.text_scenario: Your electricity bill is due today and you want to pay it.
examples: Electricity bill pay karna hai
Bijli ka bill bhar do please
Light bill ka payment karo

scenarios.text_scenario: Your phone is about to run out of balance and you want to recharge.
examples: Mera mobile recharge kar do
Phone mein recharge daalo
299 ka recharge karo

scenarios.text_scenario: You are out somewhere unfamiliar and need cash urgently.
examples: Pass mein koi ATM hai kya?
Yahan aas paas ATM dhundo
Nearest ATM kahan milega?

scenarios.text_scenario: You need to visit a branch in person for paperwork and want to know where and when.
examples: Nearest branch kahan hai batao
Branch kitne baje tak khuli hai?
Mujhe branch ka address chahiye

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to open your first savings account and are asking how to start.
examples: Naya savings account kaise kholu?
Account open karna hai, kya chahiye?
Account kholne ka process batao

scenarios.text_scenario: You have heard about zero-balance accounts and want to know if you can get one.
examples: Zero balance account mil sakta hai?
Minimum balance kitna rakhna padta hai?
Bina paise ke account khul jayega?

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker says something that is clearly not a banking request at all — everyday chit-chat.
examples: Aaj mausam kaisa rahega?
Koi acchi movie suggest karo
Khana kya banau aaj?

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker asks something that belongs to a different domain (travel, education, assistant).
examples: Meri train ka PNR status batao
Ye maths ka sawaal solve kar do
Gaana chala do koi

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker only greets or mumbles, with no actual request.
examples: Hello, haan ji
Achha theek hai
Hmm, kuch nahi
